variant.briefing:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent [TargetName] undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, [TargetName] was heading to [Location] to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid [TargetName] might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to [TargetName] and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if [TargetName] is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at [Destination] and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.
